the micronucleus assay is a sensitive biomarker of cancer susceptibility in patients with mesothelioma.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the increased micronuclei frequencies in PBL of patients with pleura malignant mesotheliomas could be related with SV40 viral infection and/or with other endogenous and/or exogenous factors.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the micronuclei assay in PBL could be a useful tool to evaluate cancer susceptibility in mesotheliomas.
the micronuclei test in PBLs may be used as a biomarker to detect the presence of SV 40 in mesotheliomas and lung cancers.
